text:
Ana (Finance): @here quick procurement update — small set of rule changes for cloud credits, reserved capacity, and vendor onboarding. Effective Mon Apr 4. Please read: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Cloud+Commits+Guidance :spiral_calendar:

Mike L: Clarifying q — the $50k threshold you mentioned, is that per purchase order or aggregated per vendor per quarter?

Ana (Finance): Per purchase / commitment. If teams try to split one intent into multiple smaller contracts to avoid review we'll flag it and route for sign-off. :eyes:

Jordan P: For Dedicated GPU reserved capacity (annual commit), is that treated as OpEx or CapEx? Need to know which approval path and GL to use.

Sasha (Accounting): Hi — Dedicated capacity is treated as OpEx (service subscription) for now. Use GL-4200 - "Cloud Infrastructure Services". For true hardware purchases/on-prem racks, submit a CAPEX request via the CAPEX form. Example snippet to include in the ticket:

```
expense_type: "Dedicated capacity (annual commit)"
gl_account: "GL-4200"
project_code: "PROJ-INFR-<team>"
```

Ana (Finance): Also two quick policy points: PCard may NOT be used for vendor contracts > $5k. And vendor onboarding > $25k requires vendor risk review + SOC2/terms attestation. New vendor checklist is linked in the page.

procure-bot: procurement ticket created: FIN-2026-1123 by DevOps (Infra) — status: awaiting finance review.

DevOps (Infra): I opened FIN-2026-1123 and uploaded the Dedicated commit quote. Can you confirm Finance turnaround SLA?

Ana (Finance): Review SLA is 3 business days for complete submissions. If Legal redlines or vendor wants contract changes, add ~5-7 business days. Please attach SOW + pricing and select the correct project code.

Mike L: If we need faster approval for a launch, is there an expedited path?

Ana (Finance): Yes — use the emergency fast-path: add the tag "expedite" to the ticket and include PM + Eng manager sign-off in the ticket. Finance will triage same day but Legal sign-offs may still be required. Prefix subject with [EXPEDITE].

Jordan P: Great, will include PM sign-off and project code.

Sasha (Accounting): Quick note on billing: invoices for committed capacity that are billed upfront should reference a PO and be emailed to ap@redwood.com with the PO#. If a PO comes in late we'll still process but invoice recognition and payment timing may shift.

Mike L: got it, thanks!

Ana (Finance): TL;DR: new $50k sign-off for cloud credit/commits; PCard cap $5k for contracts; vendor onboarding >$25k needs risk review. Full details + checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Cloud+Commits+Guidance

Jordan P: :thumbsup: saving this.

Sasha (Accounting): I'll add the vendor checklist to the ticket template now.
